about: The collecta of the formulary “Third Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Almighty, everlasting God, look graciously upon our weakness and stretch forth the right hand of Thy majesty to protect us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
